value.rationale: Classifying all equality codes of a natural finite exact two-user channel distinguishes balanced 6x6 and asymmetric 4x9 optimal designs and their full 11 symmetry classes; the count reduces 2448 labeled implementations to eleven distinct architectures. It supplies design alternatives and equality structure not recoverable merely from the known capacity bound. No general asymptotic claim is made.
